input.summary: Add Array defence duty and IP/law/data/misconduct indemnity heads; narrow Ono's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] We added Array's express duty to defend and extended its indemnity to third-party IP infringement claims, Array's breach of Law, Array-caused disclosure of Ono Confidential Information and Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and correspondingly narrowed Ono's indemnity to Ono-supplied content and Ono's breach of Law; the notice, control and cooperation mechanics in Section 16.3 are unchanged.

ops.oldText: Array shall indemnify and hold harmless
ops.newText: Array shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless

ops.oldText: and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
ops.newText: (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, (e) notwithstanding Section 11.4, any allegation that the Array Patents, Array Know-How or Products supplied by Array infringe any Third Party intellectual property right, (f) Array's breach of applicable Law, (g) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Ono Confidential Information caused by Array, or (h) Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.

ops.oldText: (a) the use, marketing, distribution, importation or sale of any Product by Ono, its Affiliates or Sublicensees in the Ono Territory, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom;
ops.newText: (a) any materials, data or other content provided by Ono to Array; and

ops.oldText: (b) injury or death of patients participating in any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Ono anywhere in the world, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (c) injury or death of patients participating in Clinical Studies conducted under any Joint Development Plan and sponsored by or on behalf of Ono, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Ono in Article 15 above; except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of an Array Indemnitee.
ops.newText: (b) any breach of applicable Law by Ono; except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of an Array Indemnitee.
